name: demographics
description: Demographics dimension table; single (non-partitioned) Parquet file. Shared globally across domains.

columns.name: demographic
columns.description: Canonical demographic code (snake_case). Primary key; natural join key for every fact table's demographic FK.

columns.name: demographic_category
columns.description: Category the demographic belongs to (e.g. race, gender, economic, special_population, grade, aggregate).

semantics.mutual_exclusivity: Not guaranteed: groups overlap across categories and may be nested within one (active_duty is a subset of military_connected in some datasets). Read the topic's definitions and non_additive declarations. Counts reconcile only for complete, disjoint, available groups; rates generally do not add.
semantics.denominator: When published, 'all' is the total within the other selected filters. Never add it to its subgroups. Subgroup rates use their own group's denominator.
semantics.combined_buckets: Never combine asian_pacific_islander with its split asian/pacific_islander components for the same population and period. A topic may change convention between years; its enum can therefore contain both conventions.
semantics.code_source: This dimension is data-driven and carries no enum of demographic codes; the canonical code list is the UNION of the per-topic fact-table demographic enums, which remain the source of truth for validating a fact's demographic values.
